sloka: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम् ।निशम्याहं ततः शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रुवम् ।। ५.६८.१६ ।।।।
transliteration: tadarthopahitaṁ vākyaṁ praśritaṁ hetusaṁhitam ।niśamyāhaṁ tataḥ śeṣaṁ vākyamuttaramabruvam ।। 5.68.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hearing the meaningful, courteous and reasonable words of Sita, I replied :
